t: The LAP Telloy round bathroom wall spotlight is a mains-powered indoor light fixture designed to provide targeted directional illumination. This brushed steel metal spotlight is ideal for domestic bathrooms, en suites and utility spaces, offering a stylish lighting solution. Featuring an adjustable head and a durable plastic diffuser, the unit is rated IP44 for safe installation in bathroom zone 2. The fixture requires a single 5W GU10 bulb and comes complete with fixings for a quick and straightforward wall-mounted installation.
